subject: Rhandsontable Crash Upon Loading On Server

messages.author: fa8b9dad524607ca
messages.subject: Rhandsontable Crash Upon Loading On Server
parts:
Good morning,

I have developed an app that utilizes an interactive Rhandsontable.  The entire app works perfectly fine when run locally, but when run on the Shiny server, it runs until after the rhandsontable is output and then it crashes.  It functions when the iris dataset is turned into a rhansontable and loaded, and I have not been able to determine why other data tables fail. 

I have implemented a minimal reproducible example with moo.rda (the rhandsontable object) attached:

## CoIapp.R ##
library('shiny')
library('shinythemes')
library('plyr')
library('xlsx')
library('rhandsontable')
library('shinysky')


shinyApp(
ui = fluidPage(theme = shinytheme("flatly"),
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
        actionButton("table1button", "Start"),
         downloadLink('downloadTable', 'Download Table')
           ),
           mainPanel(
           rHandsontableOutput('hot')
          
           )
      )
  ),
 
server = function(input, output, session) {

#author <- input$name
#authorFilter <- 'Fertig ET'
#affiliationFilter <- 'Northeast Regional Epilepsy Group'

# Take a reactive dependency on input$button, but
# not on any of the stuff inside the function
queryTable <- eventReactive(input$table1button, {

load("moo.rda")
  sdat=moo
     
sdat
})

output$table=renderTable({
if(is.null(queryTable())){return(NULL)}
#browser()
queryTable()
})

  data <- reactiveValues(df=queryTable)

output$hot <- renderRHandsontable({
queryTable()
})

savedTable=eventReactive(input$table1button, {
moo2=hot_to_r(input$hot)
moo2=moo2[moo2$Valid.Pub,]
moo2=moo2[,-1]
moo2

})

 output$downloadTable <- downloadHandler(
   filename = function() {
     paste('COIbyInstitute', Sys.Date(), '.csv', sep='')
   },
   content = function(file) {
     #save output

    
COIByInstitute=savedTable()    

write.csv(as.matrix(COIByInstitute),file=file, row.names = F,quote=FALSE)


   }
 )


}
)
